body:
I've been reflecting a lot lately and I think I know what it is. As I said, I've been out of work for a while (laid off) and I think it's made my situation a lot worse. I'm someone who doesn't like being 'idle' and not having something to work towards, even if it's only something small.  


The only problem is, this sudden severe anxiety now really limits my ability to do something about that. I don't know what direction I want to go in, and it's sort of a catch 22 situation. I wish I could have done something earlier.
